findings.message: Gateway "gw1" (exclusiveGateway) has only 1 incoming and 1 outgoing flow — it is redundant.
findings.suggestion: Remove this gateway and connect its source directly to its target.
Name start events using "Object + past participle", e.g. "Order Received", "Payment Initiated".
Name end events using "Object + state", e.g. "Order Fulfilled", "Payment Failed", "Request Rejected".

findings.message: Exclusive gateway "gw1" has only one outgoing flow and is a pass-through.
findings.suggestion: Remove this gateway and connect its source directly to its target.

findings.message: Start event "s" has no documentation describing expected input variables.
findings.suggestion: Add documentation listing the process input variables so callers know the expected contract.
Set isExecutable="true" — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a non-executable process.

fixes.xml:

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="e">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_0000001</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_0000001" sourceRef="s" targetRef="e"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
